summary: R04/R05/R06 recovery commit plus the committed R01/R02/R03/R08 work now pushed to dev. R04: manager gates the inbound control transport on account.enabled && controlEnabled (applyAccount never starts it; ingest returns FORBIDDEN after the stale-epoch check so D04 precedence holds); notifications stay independent; the acceptance test moved into test/unit so the runner executes it. R05: telegram runLoop advances the cursor only on accepted/DUPLICATE, aborts the batch otherwise (STALE_EPOCH quiet, others fatal so the connection degrades), and throws when cursorStore.commit fails so the next getUpdates never uses an uncommitted offset. R06: provider start() fails fast and routes fatal background exits through onFatal, which runtime/manager.mjs now wires into provider.start, projecting a real degraded connection/health. Suite: 356 tests pass, npm run check passes (72 source files). Docs synced (CHANGELOG, HANDOFF, PROGRESS, README); evidence/R04–R06.json added; handoff/ package added for the next agent.
